# HisaabNow

> HisaabNow is a billing and POS web app (PWA) for small shops and food businesses in India. It runs on a phone or desktop, in English and Hindi, and supports Hindi and English voice billing, GST invoices, stock tracking, udhaar (customer credit) and profit reports. Built in Noida, India. 7-day free trial with all features, no card needed.

Pricing changes, so it is not listed here. See https://hisaabnow.com/ for current plans.

## Product pages by business type
- [Kirana billing app](https://hisaabnow.com/kirana-billing-app): billing for kirana and general stores. Barcode scanning, udhaar khaata with WhatsApp reminders, low-stock alerts.
- [Grocery billing software](https://hisaabnow.com/grocery-billing-software): billing for grocery stores and mini-marts. Barcode scanning, udhaar khaata, low-stock alerts.
- [Salon billing software](https://hisaabnow.com/salon-billing-software): salons and beauty parlours. Stylist commission tracking, appointments with WhatsApp confirmations and reminders.
- [Cafe billing software](https://hisaabnow.com/cafe-billing-software): cafes and coffee shops. Ingredient-level stock tracking.
- [Restaurant POS](https://hisaabnow.com/restaurant-pos): restaurants and dhabas. Table-wise billing, KOT printing, recipe-based costing, table reservations.
- [Sweet shop billing software](https://hisaabnow.com/sweet-shop-billing-software): sweet shops and mithai stores. Expiry alerts.
- [Bakery billing software](https://hisaabnow.com/bakery-billing-software): bakeries. Low-stock alerts, udhaar tracking, WhatsApp receipts.
- [About HisaabNow](https://hisaabnow.com/about)

## Free tools (no signup)
- [GST invoice generator](https://hisaabnow.com/tools/gst-invoice-generator): fill in shop, customer and items; get a GST invoice with HSN and CGST/SGST to print or save as PDF.
- [GST calculator](https://hisaabnow.com/tools/gst-calculator): add or remove GST, with CGST/SGST or IGST split.
- [Profit margin calculator](https://hisaabnow.com/tools/profit-margin-calculator): margin vs markup from cost and selling price.
